mechanism: Amitriptyline may increase CNS depression and anticholinergic effects; ethambutol can cause optic neuritis and peripheral neuropathy which may be potentiated by amitriptyline's anticholinergic properties and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for enhanced anticholinergic effects, CNS depression, and optic/neurological symptoms; consider alternative antidepressant if possible during TB treatment.
